stem:

\(2\,\text{HI(g)} \rightarrow \text{H}_2 + \text{I}_2\text{(g)}\)

is \(209.5\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}\) at 581K. Calculate the fraction of molecules of reactants having energy equal to or greater than activation energy?

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:
From the rate expression for the following reactions, determine their order of reaction and the dimensions of the rate constants.

(i) \(3\text{NO}(g) \rightarrow \text{N}_2\text{O}(g)\)   Rate \(= k[\text{NO}]^2\)

(ii) \(\text{H}_2\text{O}_2(aq) + 3\text{I}^-(aq) + 2\text{H}^+ \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) + \text{I}_3^-\)   Rate \(= k[\text{H}_2\text{O}_2][\text{I}^-]\)

(iii) \(\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}(g) \rightarrow \text{CH}_4(g) + \text{CO}(g)\)   Rate \(= k[\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}]^{3/2}\)

(iv) \(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{Cl}(g) \rightarrow \text{C}_2\text{H}_4(g) + \text{HCl}(g)\)   Rate \(= k[\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{Cl}]\)

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:
For the reaction:

\(2\text{A} + \text{B} \rightarrow \text{A}_2\text{B}\)

the rate \(= k[\text{A}][\text{B}]^2\) with \(k = 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{mol}^{-2}\,\text{L}^{2}\,\text{s}^{-1}\). Calculate the initial rate of the reaction when \([\text{A}] = 0.1\,\text{mol L}^{-1}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.2\,\text{mol L}^{-1}\). Calculate the rate of reaction after \([\text{A}]\) is reduced to \(0.06\,\text{mol L}^{-1}\).

subtopic: Rate of a Chemical Reaction
stem: The decomposition of \(\text{NH}_3\) on platinum surface is zero order reaction. What are the rates of production of \(\text{N}_2\) and \(\text{H}_2\) if \(k = 2.5 \times 10^{-4}\,\text{mol}^{-1}\,\text{L}\,\text{s}^{-1}\)?

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:
The decomposition of dimethyl ether leads to the formation of \(\text{CH}_4\), \(\text{H}_2\) and \(\text{CO}\) and the reaction rate is given by

Rate \(= k\,[\text{CH}_3\text{OCH}_3]^{3/2}\)

The rate of reaction is followed by increase in pressure in a closed vessel, so the rate can also be expressed in terms of the partial pressure of dimethyl ether, i.e.,

Rate \(= k\left(p_{\text{CH}_3\text{OCH}_3}\right)^{3/2}\)

If the pressure is measured in bar and time in minutes, then what are the units of rate and rate constants?

subtopic: Rate of a Chemical Reaction
stem:

| \(t/\text{s}\) | 0 | 30 | 60 | 90 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| \([\text{A}]/\text{mol L}^{-1}\) | 0.55 | 0.31 | 0.17 | 0.085 |

Calculate the average rate of reaction between the time interval 30 to 60 seconds.

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:
A reaction is first order in A and second order in B.

(i) Write the differential rate equation.
(ii) How is the rate affected on increasing the concentration of B three times?
(iii) How is the rate affected when the concentrations of both A and B are doubled?

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:
In a reaction between A and B, the initial rate of reaction \((r_0)\) was measured for different initial concentrations of A and B as given below:

| \(\text{A}/\text{mol L}^{-1}\) | 0.20 | 0.20 | 0.40 |
|---|---|---|---|
| \(\text{B}/\text{mol L}^{-1}\) | 0.30 | 0.10 | 0.05 |
| \(r_0/\text{mol L}^{-1}\text{s}^{-1}\) | \(5.07 \times 10^{-5}\) | \(5.07 \times 10^{-5}\) | \(1.43 \times 10^{-4}\) |

What is the order of the reaction with respect to A and B?

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:
The following results have been obtained during the kinetic studies of the reaction:

\(2\text{A} + \text{B} \rightarrow \text{C} + \text{D}\)

| Experiment | \([\text{A}]/\text{mol L}^{-1}\) | \([\text{B}]/\text{mol L}^{-1}\) | Initial rate of formation of \(\text{D}/\text{mol L}^{-1}\text{min}^{-1}\) |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | 0.1 | 0.1 | \(6.0 \times 10^{-3}\) |
| II | 0.3 | 0.2 | \(7.2 \times 10^{-2}\) |
| III | 0.3 | 0.4 | \(2.88 \times 10^{-1}\) |
| IV | 0.4 | 0.1 | \(2.40 \times 10^{-2}\) |

Determine the rate law and the rate constant for the reaction.

subtopic: Factors Influencing Rate of a Reaction
stem:

|---|---|---|---|
| I | 0.1 | 0.1 | \(2.0 \times 10^{-2}\) |
| II | - | 0.2 | \(4.0 \times 10^{-2}\) |

| IV | - | 0.2 | \(2.0 \times 10^{-2}\) |

subtopic: Integrated Rate Equations
stem: The half-life for radioactive decay of \(^{14}\text{C}\) is 5730 years. An archaeological artifact containing wood had only 80% of the \(^{14}\text{C}\) found in a living tree. Estimate the age of the sample.

subtopic: Integrated Rate Equations
stem:
The experimental data for decomposition of \(\text{N}_2\text{O}_5\)

\([2\text{N}_2\text{O}_5 \rightarrow 4\text{NO}_2 + \text{O}_2]\)

in gas phase at 318K are given below:

| \(t/\text{s}\) | 0 | 400 | 800 | 1200 | 1600 | 2000 | 2400 | 2800 | 3200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| \(10^2 \times [\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]/\text{mol L}^{-1}\) | 1.63 | 1.36 | 1.14 | 0.93 | 0.78 | 0.64 | 0.53 | 0.43 | 0.35 |

(i) Plot \([\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]\) against \(t\).
(ii) Find the half-life period for the reaction.
(iii) Draw a graph between \(\log[\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]\) and \(t\).
(iv) What is the rate law ?
(v) Calculate the rate constant.
(vi) Calculate the half-life period from \(k\) and compare it with (ii).

stem:
